original_test_intent: Validate each Type 42 management host-interface payload under the correct SMBIOS revision and Interface Type, including bounds, required vendor/transport data and following protocol records, with secure evidence and reboot stability.
original_method: Select the revision/interface-specific payload layout, preserve raw bytes securely, reconcile offsets/data-length/minimum/vendor fields and protocol records against the structure boundary, compare decoded design with approved controller inventory and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies payload/OEM/protocol semantics, evidence policy and reboot approval; bounded parsing is automated and bytes are never executed.
required_inputs: Advertised SMBIOS revision and selected Interface Type
Expected interface-specific payload/protocol schema and controller mapping
OEM/IANA or MCTP assignment data where applicable
Restricted evidence handling and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Treat payload bytes only as data; never send or execute them as controller commands.
Use read-only table/inventory collection and do not reset/reconfigure BMC interfaces.
Select layout before reading offsets; bounds-check every variable field/record.
Protect sensitive management metadata; stop on health loss and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Select revision/interface branch, validate payload offsets/lengths/minimum/vendor/protocol bounds, securely preserve raw evidence, compare approved interface design and diff across reboot.
Report malformed, unknown, mismatched or drifting payloads without assigning PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve payload schema, vendor/protocol semantics, redaction/access policy and reboot recovery.
Interpret vendor-defined content and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but a one-line grep cannot establish revision-specific offset, bounds, vendor identity or protocol-record integrity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Store complete raw Type 42 under access control; emit revision/interface branch, payload offsets/lengths, vendor/transport decode, protocol record table and pre/post result with ordinary-report redaction.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The MC Host Interface Data scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no payload is executed.

modernized_recommendation.status: SECURE REVISION- AND INTERFACE-SPECIFIC PAYLOAD VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Choose the correct layout from SMBIOS revision and Interface Type, validate all nested payload/protocol bounds and required vendor identifiers, then compare structure/interface identity across reboot under controlled evidence handling.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, assignment/OEM schema, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and management-inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 42 host-interface data and protocol-record definitions plus authoritative vendor/assignment schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces text grep with secure raw parsing of revision-dependent variable data.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects layout shifts, truncated/overrunning payloads, missing vendor identity, malformed protocol records and semantic mismatch.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Applicable payload schema, vendor/protocol policy and secure storage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Declarative payload correctness does not prove live protocol behavior; active commands require a separate approved test.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define OEM payloads or report redaction, but must preserve an authorized exact raw comparison and cannot execute payload bytes or ignore bounds.
expected_evidence: Restricted pre-reboot raw Type 42 with header/interface/payload context
Redacted ordinary report plus authorized exact comparison
Approved reboot/management health record and post-reboot semantic diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: MC Host Interface Data is intentionally variable; its governing revision/interface context makes it deterministically reviewable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bounded payload parsing and comparison are fully automatable after schema/security inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds revision/interface layout, nested bounds, vendor/protocol meaning and protected evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains secure no-execution boundaries while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates private schema/storage/reboot readiness and formal verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents bytes shifted by the wrong SMBIOS layout or malformed nested records from appearing as a plausible data string, while avoiding payload disclosure/execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: The payload is a discriminated, revision-dependent binary structure; safe correctness requires selecting its schema first, bounding every component and treating content as untrusted data.
